comparison.objective: Open a folding fan fully while keeping one guard stick fixed.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization and sweeping a second stick around a stiff pivot.
comparison.success_condition: Fan spread at least 135 degrees, lying on its stand, with arms returned for full credit.
comparison.reason: Arc motion around a pivot shares generic rotation only; it lacks tool use, a moving lock socket, bounded tightening, and response-based adjustment.
